pattern.description: With the Export menu held open, the shot cross-dissolves from one project (dark-mode phone app) to another (globe route map) while pulling out slightly; the cursor keeps travelling down the menu and lands on Handoff to Claude Code.
pattern.why_premium: Keeping the menu and cursor as a continuous anchor while the canvas behind swaps projects implies 'this works for every design' in a third of a second, without a cut.

build_hint.gsap: Stack take A and take B; tl.fromTo('.take-b', {opacity: 0, scale: 1.06, y: 24}, {opacity: 1, scale: 1, y: 0, duration: 0.35, ease: 'power2.out'}).to('.take-a', {opacity: 0, scale: 0.98, duration: 0.35, ease: 'power1.inOut'}, '<'); cursor y tween down the menu (ease 'power2.inOut'); row highlight set instantly as the cursor crosses rows.
build_hint.remotion: Two layers in one <Sequence>; B opacity = interpolate(frame, [0, 9], [0, 1], {extrapolateRight: 'clamp'}), B scale = interpolate(frame, [0, 9], [1.06, 1], {easing: Easing.out(Easing.quad)}); A opacity mirrors it. Cursor position via interpolate with Easing.inOut(Easing.cubic); no spring needed (no overshoot).

notes: No SFX candidates in this window. Code camera verdict is pull_out (scale 0.944), consistent with the visual. Same construction as e014 (dissolve between takes with the Export menu as anchor); toolbar state differences (Tweaks, Comment) are take differences, not authored animations.
